title: Everpure Reports Q3 Revenue of $1.5 Billion, Raises Guidance
summary: Everpure reported third-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $1.5 billion, up 51% year-over-year, and raised its full-year revenue and operating income guidance.
body_markdown:
GAAP operating income was $150 million and non-GAAP operating income was $345 million, for a GAAP operating margin of 10.3% and a non-GAAP operating margin of 23.6%. GAAP gross margin was 68.0% and non-GAAP gross margin was 69.2%. Everpure reported operating cash flow of $443 million and free cash flow of $265 million, and it returned approximately $67 million to stockholders through repurchases of 0.5 million shares.


For the fourth quarter of fiscal 2027, the company guided revenue of $1.50 billion to $1.52 billion and non-GAAP operating income of $350 million to $360 million. It raised its full-year revenue guidance to $5.20 billion to $5.21 billion, from $5.03 billion to $5.07 billion, and its non-GAAP operating income guidance to $1.08 billion to $1.09 billion, from $940 million to $960 million. Everpure said these statements are forward-looking and actual results may differ materially.


## Why It Matters for P


The new full-year range carries a revenue growth rate of 42%, up from 37% to 38% in the prior guidance, according to the release. CFO Tarek Robbiati said the company delivered record revenue and operating income, "exceeding the high end of our guidance," and is "raising full-year guidance for the third consecutive quarter and reiterating our strong preliminary FY28 outlook."
